description:
Get project event log entries.

Returns `events`: an array of entries with `id` (event identifier), `time` (ISO 8601 UTC), `actor` (initiator of the event), `event_type` (event type identifier), `event_desc` (event description), and `service_name`.


This tool may return a long list; results support filtering and pagination to narrow large catalogs.

limit.description: Max items to return. Do NOT set this unless the user explicitly asked for a specific number of results.

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Use the value from the `next_offset` field in a previous response to fetch the next page.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter. Matches against `actor`, `event_type`, `event_desc`, `service_name`. Only items containing this string are returned.

name: aiven_project_get_event_logs
title: Project Get Event Logs
